adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference is changed to an array via .filter(...includes("_calendar")). The code then loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that per-reference loop, the recurring/allRemainingBookings branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) builds `promises` over *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` and then for *all* `updatedBookings` deletes their calendar refs, pushing results into `apiDeletes`. This recurring branch does not use the current `reference`’s `uid/externalCalendarId` and will therefore re-run the full deletion set once per reference, duplicating delete API calls and `apiDeletes` entries when multiple calendar references exist.
